Quantum University vs Uttaranchal University is a private-university commerce comparison. The highest packages on our records look unusually high for undergraduate commerce, so confirm them from an official report before you lean on them.

sections.heading: Quantum University vs Uttaranchal University for BCom: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Quantum University if you want a recorded year tuition of ₹52,000 for B.Com or ₹62,000 for the honours rows, and you will confirm the 2023 banking and insurance placement of ₹6 lakh average and ₹34 lakh highest from an official report.
Choose Uttaranchal University if you want the recorded honours programmes with ACCA or CMA, at a year tuition of ₹1,35,300, after you confirm the 2023 highest of ₹41 lakh from an official report.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Quantum University we hold year tuition of ₹62,000 for B.Com (Hons) Banking & Insurance and B.Com (Hons) General, and ₹52,000 for B.Com. These are year figures, not confirmed three-year official totals.
For Uttaranchal University we hold year tuition of ₹1,35,300 for B.Com (Hons) International Finance and Accounting with ACCA, UK, and for Corporate Accounting and Financial Analysis with CMA, US.
Confirm the current notices on quantumuniversity.edu.in and uttaranchaluniversity.ac.in, including any professional-body charges that sit outside tuition.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Quantum University has a 2023 B.Com (Hons) Banking & Insurance row of ₹6 lakh average and ₹34 lakh highest. Uttaranchal University has a 2023 ACCA honours row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹41 lakh highest.

Those highest figures are unusually high for undergraduate commerce. Treat them as recorded historical rows, not as a typical outcome, and ask both placement cells for the official 2023 or later report.
Neither college has a NIRF or India Today rank on this page.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each university's official undergraduate admissions process.
Our table has no ranking rows for either college in this comparison. Do not invent a rank that is not listed here.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Quantum University is recorded in Roorkee, Uttarakhand. Uttaranchal University is recorded in Dehradun. They are not the same city, even though Quantum's profile slug mentions Dehradun.
Both are private universities. Visit the campus you would actually join, and match the exact B.Com or honours stream, including any ACCA or CMA arrangement.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Quantum University if the lower recorded year tuition and the Roorkee campus fit you, after you have confirmed fees and the 2023 placement row in writing.
Pick Uttaranchal University if the ACCA or CMA honours programmes in Dehradun are the goal, after you have confirmed the official tuition and placement report.
Do not decide from the ₹34 lakh or ₹41 lakh highest rows alone.
